_comment: Hand-authored fixes layered over data/kushy/raw/ (never edit the raw scrape). Ops: dropStrains[], dropEdges[{parent,child}], overrideStrains[{id,...}], addStrains[], addEdges[] (ids are kushy-<n>); aliases{ aliasName: canonicalName } folds same-strain spellings/abbreviations onto one node. Exact-name duplicates merge automatically — only list abbreviations that DON'T normalize equal. Never alias distinct-but-related strains (NYC Diesel is not Sour Diesel).
